answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent could post a small bonded stake that sits locked like an ember under ash: it slowly vests only after peers attest to its useful work over many epochs. A swarm of fake identities must split capital across every clone, so the attacker's cost grows linearly while their influence does not. Stakes from caught sybils are slashed into a shared river of rewards for honest graders, bending incentives the way a willow bends toward water.
